name: m@iLove!
source:
There's a lot of private stuff on a PC!
A wonderful world of things about her loved one that she might not know just yet...
But the pesky password is in the loving maiden's way!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE033593.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
电脑里存着许多私人内容！
其中有一个精彩世界，装满了她尚不知道的、关于心爱之人的事情…
然而，讨厌的密码挡在恋爱少女面前！

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE033593.html]DLsite English[/url]]
